verses.text: "God rules, and everyone should fear him. He makes peace in the high heavens.
Can anyone count his armies? Is there anyone his light does not shine on?
So how can a human be right before God? How can anyone born of a woman be pure?
If even the moon is not bright and the stars are not pure in his sight,
how much less a human, who is only a maggot, a human being, who is only a worm!"
